summary: Minimal, targeted fix that calls update_datalim on the step patch coordinates so density-scaled step histograms autoscale the y-axis correctly, matching the non-step histtype behavior. Correctly addresses the reported bug with no apparent regression risk.

issues.description: Comment '# Update data limits' is terse; a brief note on why step histtype needs explicit datalim update (patches don't auto-register extents) would aid maintainability, but acceptable.

update_datalim inside the per-dataset loop stacks column of (x,y) including baseline y=0; benign for typical cases but slight interaction possibility with log-scale/bottom offsets is untested — low risk, not blocking.
